summary: Iter-11 full validation: custom pay (worker default + per-gig override), auto-earnings on clock-out, timesheet approval gate, admin reports (filters, totals, CSV), Google Sheets export error path, and worker earnings view. 23/23 backend tests PASS. Frontend pages and dialogs render and behave correctly.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Caused by Emergent x-source-* span wrappers inside <option> tags in worker-filter <select>. Cosmetic; does not affect functionality.

action_items: (Optional) The dev wrapper injects <span> children into <option> in AdminReports.jsx line ~199 causing a hydration warning. If main agent wants to silence it, render the worker label as a plain string (no JSX expression with attributes) inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: _resolve_pay precedence is correctly implemented (per-gig override > worker default > gig posted) and is verified via three separate tests including override-on-clocked-out which resets timesheet_approved.
Approve/unapprove correctly gates worker visibility of earnings; /api/me/earnings excludes pending and the gig list shows per-gig earnings only when approved.
Reports endpoint returns rows + totals (rows, hours, earnings, approved_earnings) and the CSV download has correct headers/columns. only_approved=true correctly excludes pending rows.
Google Sheets export returns a clean 400 with a descriptive 'service account not configured' message when not configured — verified.
server.py is 2,400+ lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, gigs, pay/timesheets, reports, settings) for maintainability.
MongoDB ObjectId is correctly excluded throughout.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of UI checks (reports, settings, worker detail default-pay card, gig detail roster with Rate/Earned/TS columns, PayOverrideDialog, worker /app/accepted earnings KPIs)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@hcobcleaners.com / HcobAdmin2026!; created multiple disposable TEST_iter11_* workers via /api/auth/register
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates and deletes its own gig + worker (TEST_iter11_* prefix). Two UI-side TEST_iter11ui_* workers + gigs were created and left in DB for visual inspection of the worker /app/accepted page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter11.py covers all new pay/earnings/timesheet/reports endpoints with positive + negative cases. _force_clock() helper writes clock_in_at/clock_out_at directly to gig_acceptances to bypass real-time waiting; pay snapshot is established by calling PUT acceptance/pay with clear_rate:true (no-op that triggers recompute). All test data uses TEST_ prefix and is cleaned up by deleting the parent gig.
